create_cmvn_normalizer: create a CMVN normalizer with specified dimension, means, and inverse standard variance values for feature normalization
build_fbank_extractor: build a KaldifeatFbank extractor with configurable mel bins, frame length, frame shift, and dither parameters for log-mel filterbank computation
extract_fbank_features: extract 80-dim log-mel filterbank features from raw speech waveform using kaldi_native_fbank with CMVN normalization
pad_audio_features: pad audio feature sequences to uniform length and compute speech lengths and fake token lengths for encoder output
process_audio_text: process audio waveform and text input together to produce feature inputs with tokenized labels for speech recognition
